SELECT step1.player_id, step1.throws, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS FLOAT) / step2.total_cnt as ratio FROM (SELECT ma.player_id, p.throws, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.throws) step1 JOIN (SELECT p.throws, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM (SELECT ma.player_id, p.throws, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.throws) GROUP BY p.throws) step2 ON step1.throws = step2.throws ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT pc.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, c.state), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.college_id, s1.state, s1.cnt, s1.cnt / s2.avg_cnt as ratio_to_avg FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.college_id, s3.state, s3.cnt, s3.ratio_to_avg, s3.cnt / s4.total_count as proportion FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4) SELECT s5.state, AVG(s5.cnt) as avg_cnt, AVG(s5.ratio_to_avg) as avg_ratio_to_avg, AVG(s5.proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step5 s5 GROUP BY s5.state ORDER BY s5.state

SELECT AVG(count) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM (SELECT step1.count, CAST(step1.count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(COUNT(*)) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS x) AS ratio, step1.count - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS y) AS diff FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS step1 HAVING step1.count > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film GROUP BY rating)))

SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) as avg_price_per_day, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) - (SELECT AVG(f2.rental_rate / f2.rental_duration) FROM film f2) as difference FROM film f GROUP BY f.rating HAVING (SELECT AVG(f2.rental_rate / f2.rental_duration) FROM film f2) IS NOT NULL

WITH state_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    BillingState,
    AVG(Total) as avg_total,
    COUNT(*) as state_count
  FROM Invoice
  WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_count) as total FROM state_stats
)
SELECT 
  state_stats.BillingState,
  state_stats.avg_total,
  state_stats.state_count,
  state_stats.state_count * 1.0 / total_count.total as proportion
FROM state_stats
CROSS JOIN total_count
ORDER BY state_stats.BillingState

SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) as col1, AVG(total_records) as col2, AVG(avg_ratio) as col3 FROM (SELECT c.Company, AVG(step1.avg_unit_price) as avg_unit_price, SUM(step1.record_count) as total_records, AVG(CAST(step1.record_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(COUNT(*)) FROM InvoiceLine il2 JOIN Invoice i2 ON il2.InvoiceId = i2.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c2 ON i2.CustomerId = c2.CustomerId GROUP BY il2.InvoiceId, c2.Company)) as avg_ratio FROM (SELECT il.InvoiceId, c.Company, AVG(il.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Company) step1 GROUP BY c.Company)

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    AVG(b.amount) as event_avg
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_avg) as overall_avg FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.event_name,
    s1.event_avg,
    s1.event_avg - s2.overall_avg as difference
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.event_avg > s2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.event_name,
  s3.event_avg,
  s3.difference,
  s3.event_avg / s4.avg_difference as result
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT major.college, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM member
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.college
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.college, step1.count, CAST(step1.count AS REAL) / step2.total_count as ratio
  FROM step1, step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT step3.college, step3.count, step3.ratio, step3.count - step4.avg_ratio as difference
  FROM step3, step4
  WHERE step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT college, count, ratio, difference FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT income.source, SUM(income.amount) as total_amount FROM income GROUP BY income.source), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) as grand_total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.source, step1.total_amount, CAST(step1.total_amount AS REAL) / step2.grand_total as percentage FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.grand_total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(percentage) as avg_percentage FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.source, step3.total_amount, step3.percentage, step3.total_amount - step4.avg_percentage as diff FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step3.percentage > step4.avg_percentage) SELECT AVG(total_amount) as avg_amount, AVG(percentage) as avg_percentage, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step5
Step 6 – Compute the final aggregation

WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(s1.avg_ana) as overall_avg_ana FROM step1 WHERE s1.avg_ana IS NOT NULL) SELECT step1.SEX, step1.avg_acl_igg, step1.avg_ana, step1.avg_ana / step2.overall_avg_ana as ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg_ana IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    `ANA Pattern` AS pattern,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.pattern,
    s1.avg_acl_igg,
    s1.avg_acl_igg - s2.overall_avg AS diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_acl_igg > s2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.pattern,
  s3.avg_acl_igg,
  s3.diff,
  s3.avg_acl_igg - s4.avg_diff AS final_diff
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as overall_avg_hgb FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ID, step1.avg_hgb, step1.avg_hgb - step2.overall_avg_hgb as diff FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_hgb > step2.overall_avg_hgb), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.ID, step3.avg_hgb, step3.diff, step3.avg_hgb - step4.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.avg_diff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT * FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.Diagnosis, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.Diagnosis), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.Diagnosis, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total as proportion FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3) SELECT step3.Diagnosis, step3.cnt, step3.proportion, step3.cnt - step4.avg_proportion as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_proportion IS NOT NULL AND step3.cnt > step4.avg_proportion

SELECT e.ID, COUNT(*) as exam_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Examination) as ratio, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Examination) - (SELECT AVG(CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Examination)) FROM Examination GROUP BY ID) as diff FROM Examination e GROUP BY e.ID HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Examination) > (SELECT AVG(CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM Examination)) FROM Examination GROUP BY ID) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  r.name,
  AVG(cs.points) as avg_points,
  AVG(cs.points) - 36.66569335191194 as difference_from_overall,
  AVG(cs.points) - (
    SELECT AVG(diff) FROM (
      SELECT AVG(cs2.points) - 36.66569335191194 as diff
      FROM constructorStandings cs2 
      JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = cs2.raceId 
      GROUP BY r2.name 
      HAVING AVG(cs2.points) > 36.66569335191194
    )
  ) as final_difference
FROM constructorStandings cs 
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId 
GROUP BY r.name 
HAVING AVG(cs.points) > 36.66569335191194
ORDER BY avg_points DESC

SELECT circuits.country, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM constructorResults JOIN races ON constructorResults.raceId = races.raceId JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId GROUP BY circuits.country)) as proportion, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(p) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM constructorResults JOIN races ON constructorResults.raceId = races.raceId JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId GROUP BY circuits.country)) as p FROM constructorResults JOIN races ON constructorResults.raceId = races.raceId JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId GROUP BY circuits.country)) as final_ratio FROM constructorResults JOIN races ON constructorResults.raceId = races.raceId JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId GROUP BY circuits.country ORDER BY circuits.country

WITH step1 AS (SELECT circuits.country, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM races JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId GROUP BY circuits.country), step3 AS (SELECT country, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as pct FROM step1), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(pct) as avg_pct FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT cnt, pct, cnt - (SELECT avg_pct FROM step4) as diff FROM step3 WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_pct FROM step4)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count, AVG(pct) as avg_percentage, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step5

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_races FROM races), ratios AS (SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.race_count, CAST(cc.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races as ratio FROM circuit_counts cc, total t), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM ratios), filtered AS (SELECT cc.race_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - ar.avg_ratio as diff FROM ratios r, avg_ratio ar WHERE r.ratio > ar.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(race_count) as total_races_counted, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_above_mean, AVG(diff) as avg_difference_from_mean FROM filtered

SELECT s1.fundflux, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as proportion, s1.cnt / s4.avg_prop as final_value FROM (SELECT projects.fundflux, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY projects.fundflux) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM scanqc JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry) s2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanqc JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry)) as avg_prop FROM (SELECT projects.fundflux, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY projects.fundflux)) s4

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.arcref, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.arcref, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avg_ratio as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.cnt > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT sp.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(sp.boxx / sp.boxz) as ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp 
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref 
  GROUP BY sp.arcref, p.fundflux
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(sp.boxx / sp.boxz) as avg_ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp 
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref 
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT 
  s1.arcref,
  s1.fundflux,
  s1.ratio,
  s1.ratio - s2.avg_ratio as difference
FROM step1 s1
JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.fundflux = s2.fundflux
WHERE s1.ratio > s2.avg_ratio
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT transactionrecord.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM compliancecase JOIN transactionrecord ON compliancecase.transref = transactionrecord.transreg GROUP BY transactionrecord.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ordertypedist, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total_cnt as ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.cnt, step3.ratio, step3.cnt - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step3.cnt > step4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.ordervault,
    s1.cnt,
    CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as proportion
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.ordervault,
    s3.cnt,
    s3.proportion,
    s3.cnt - s4.avg_proportion as diff
  FROM step3 s3, step4 s4

)

  AVG(proportion) as result_column_2,
  AVG(diff) as result_column_3
FROM step5

WITH step1 AS (SELECT rm.ordervault, u.acctscope, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY rm.ordervault, u.acctscope), step2 AS (SELECT acctscope, SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt FROM step1 GROUP BY acctscope), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(sum_cnt) as total_sum FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.acctscope, step2.sum_cnt, step2.sum_cnt * 1.0 / step3.total_sum as ratio FROM step2 CROSS JOIN step3 WHERE step3.total_sum IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step4), step6 AS (SELECT step4.acctscope, step4.sum_cnt, step4.ratio, step4.sum_cnt * 1.0 / step5.avg_ratio as normalized FROM step4 CROSS JOIN step5 WHERE step5.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM step6

SELECT 
  s1.observstation,
  s1.weathprofile,
  s1.count,
  ROUND(s1.count - s2.avg_count, 1) as diff
FROM (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    o.weathprofile,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile
) as s1
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(CAST(count AS REAL)) as avg_count
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      t.observstation,
      o.weathprofile,
      COUNT(*) as count
    FROM telescopes t
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile
  )
  GROUP BY weathprofile
) as s2 ON s1.weathprofile = s2.weathprofile
WHERE s1.count > s2.avg_count
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
The query above computes: average bandwidth of moon phases exceeding the overall average, total records in those phases, and average excess over the overall mean.

WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), step2 AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_avgs, SUM(record_count) as total_records FROM step1 GROUP BY lunarstage), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(avg_of_avgs) as sum_result FROM step2) SELECT s2.lunarstage, s2.avg_of_avgs, s2.total_records, CASE WHEN s3.sum_result IS NOT NULL THEN s2.avg_of_avgs / s3.sum_result ELSE NULL END as division_result FROM step2 s2 CROSS JOIN step3 s3 WHERE s3.sum_result IS NOT NULL

WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.lunarstage, step1.cnt, step1.cnt * 1.0 / step2.total_cnt as ratio FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT step3.lunarstage, step3.cnt, step3.ratio, step3.cnt / step4.avg_ratio as col4 FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step3.lunarstage

SELECT AVG(metric_val) as result FROM (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as metric_val FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) UNION ALL SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) UNION ALL SELECT AVG(proportion) FROM (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes t2 JOIN observatories o2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation) as proportion FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile))

SELECT s3.rfistat, s3.avg_modindex, s3.diff, (s3.avg_modindex - s4.avg_diff) as final_result FROM (SELECT s1.rfistat, s1.avg_modindex, (s1.avg_modindex - s2.overall_avg) as diff FROM (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat)) s2 WHERE s1.avg_modindex > s2.overall_avg) s3 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(s3b.diff) as avg_diff FROM (SELECT s1.rfistat, s1.avg_modindex, (s1.avg_modindex - s2.overall_avg) as diff FROM (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat)) s2 WHERE s1.avg_modindex > s2.overall_avg) s3b) s4
